incidents.name: UpSwing pressure-tax bypass via pair skim
incidents.notes: UpSwing's dynamic sell tax was keyed on a per-address 'pressure' counter that transfer-to-pair plus pair.skim() reset, letting the attacker wash the same balance through the pair until the tax was zero and then dump into the pool.

sources.ref: onchain review: UpSwing 0x35a254223960c18B69C0526c46B013D022E93902 created 2020-09-28T18:04:25Z by 0xe041caecce2181f24ad9e3f9c4db14ef69f4a8a6, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment. ~22 ETH x $1,580.88 at incidentTimestamp 1674046463 (DefiLlama) = $34,779.
